ai_summary: Here's the executive summary:  Aegis Logistics Limited has successfully commissioned a new specialized LPG Bottling Plant at Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPA) with an annual capacity of 35,000 MT, effective October 15, 2026. This development signifies a material expansion in the company's operational capacity and marks a key milestone for its "J2 Project" Greenfield Terminal. No immediate red flags are apparent, though the plant is slated for subsequent transfer to Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited per an earlier agreement.
